name: LoveSpark Daily Checklist
summary: Simple daily checklist that auto-resets each morning. No overwhelm, no clutter. ADHD-friendly, free, local-only.
detailed_description:
A checklist that starts fresh every morning so yesterday's unfinished tasks can't haunt you.

To-do apps are overwhelming for ADHD brains. They accumulate tasks, create guilt, and eventually become another source of anxiety. LoveSpark Daily Checklist takes the opposite approach: it auto-resets every morning. Today is a new day. You add what matters now, check it off, and tomorrow starts clean.

FEATURES

- Add tasks with a quick text input
- Check off tasks with satisfying checkboxes
- Visual progress bar showing percentage complete
- Delete tasks you decide aren't worth doing — that's a valid choice
- Daily auto-reset — your list clears each morning
- Track how many tasks you've completed today and total
- Empty state encouragement when you're starting fresh
- Clean, minimal interface — no categories, no priorities, no tags
- 4 cozy themes: Retro Pink, Dark Noir, Warm Beige, Cool Slate
- Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support

HOW IT WORKS

1. Click the Daily Checklist icon in your toolbar
2. Type a task and hit + to add it
3. Check it off when done — watch the progress bar fill up
4. Delete tasks that no longer matter
5. Tomorrow morning, the list auto-resets — fresh start, no guilt

WHY LOVESPARK

LoveSpark is built by a neurodivergent developer who has abandoned every to-do app within a week because the backlog becomes paralyzing. Daily Checklist is intentionally minimal. No recurring tasks, no due dates, no priority levels. Just today's list. The auto-reset is the feature — it prevents accumulation anxiety.

Every LoveSpark extension is free, open source, and privacy-first. We believe productivity tools should reduce anxiety, not create it.

PRIVACY FIRST

LoveSpark Daily Checklist stores all data locally in your browser. We collect zero data. No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No account required. Your data never leaves your device.

OPEN SOURCE

This extension is open source under the MIT license. View the code at github.com/Joona-t/lovespark-extensions/tree/main/productivity/lovespark-daily-checklist.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
